forms.detail: DEA Diversion Control Division (January 2026): found as tablets, capsules and powder; illicit 'repacking shops' repackaged and reformulated tablets before sale; sold as MDMA or LSD.

DEA Diversion Control Division (United States, March 2026): tablets, capsules, powder, liquid, and small squares of blotter paper. EMCDDA risk assessment (2004): powder or tablets, also liquid (Danish report); white tablets with an 'i' logo (Denmark, 2002; United Kingdom, first half of 2003); white powder (Sweden).

EMCDDA risk assessment (2004): powder or tablets, also capsules or liquid; its chemistry section gives the form as 'powder form (hydrochloride salt) or capsule/tablet'; a blue tablet with a 'Yin-yang' logo was sold in Dutch smartshops.

European Union; in the Netherlands sold in smartshops from early 2000 (EMCDDA risk assessment, 2C-T-7)
